boundedBacklogPhases.title: Manual collections and navigation
boundedBacklogPhases.description: New main `research-portfolios` module, additive Prisma tables/grants/typed membership/history, shared DTOs; new native list/detail; replace duplicate Portfolio Defense Budget entry. Link authorized clients through existing access services.
boundedBacklogPhases.acceptance: Create/edit/share/archive/restore; manually add/exclude/reinstate/resolve typed members; owner/editor/viewer and client-wall tests; Clients and current Business Development v5 unchanged in function. UI flag can hide new entry while preserving saved records/read compatibility.
boundedBacklogPhases.rollbackBoundary: Hide the new UI entry with its feature flag while preserving saved records and read compatibility.

boundedBacklogPhases.title: Taxonomy, templates and rules
boundedBacklogPhases.description: Versioned taxonomy/aliases/templates; full deterministic rule AST; explainable preview/diff/publish; manual precedence and unresolved/unknown semantics; bounded recompute jobs. Reuse capability mappings; add semantic tasks only when justified by independent evaluation.
boundedBacklogPhases.acceptance: One cross-service capability collection works with positive/negative/unknown cases; component-only template works; explicit exclusions survive updates; incomplete fetch cannot remove accepted members. Disable automation without losing manual membership/history.
boundedBacklogPhases.rollbackBoundary: Disable automation without losing manual membership or history.

boundedBacklogPhases.title: Dossier and financial foundations
boundedBacklogPhases.description: Extend current program/PE/BLI readers, schedule-period projection, narrative types, exact FYDP cell provenance and source inspector; repair execution metric/period DTO loss and supported temporal reads.
boundedBacklogPhases.acceptance: RDT&E and procurement examples expose correct narrative/milestone/date precision and edition-aware values. No unsupported historical substitution or mixed money measures. Revert projection version only through compatibility-tested readers.
boundedBacklogPhases.rollbackBoundary: Revert the projection version only through compatibility-tested readers.

boundedBacklogPhases.title: Contextual sources and references
boundedBacklogPhases.description: Extend owned source registry for missing policy/hearing families; occurrence/section parsing, source revision history and coverage contracts; retain canonical budget ingestion authority.
boundedBacklogPhases.acceptance: One missing policy family and hearing gap with exact occurrences, complete/partial inventory behavior and real denominators. Disable only new family admission; retain revisions/evidence.
boundedBacklogPhases.rollbackBoundary: Disable only new family admission and retain revisions and evidence.
